name: scroll-animation-default

frames.best_why: The masonry wall is fully built with three columns of photos, showing the finished gallery rather than a fade.

tagline: Horse photos fade and slide into a three-column wall as you scroll.
summary: A full-width gallery of horse and landscape pictures laid out in three masonry columns. Each photo starts faint and off position, then fades into place once about half of it is on screen.
appearance: A near-black page with a centred white Scroll Down heading and a downward hand emoji. Below it, photos stack in three narrow columns with small gaps, lit by bright skies and green fields against the dark ground.
behaviour: Scrolling brings each photo in on its own: it appears faint and slightly displaced, sharpens as it enters the middle of the viewport, and then stays put. Earlier rows remain and the wall fills from the top down.
demo_content: Horse portraits in fields and on moorland plus a red-and-white striped awning, under a Scroll Down prompt.
search_phrases: photos fade in as you scroll
portfolio gallery with fade up images
images that load when scrolled into view
use_when: A photo-led page wants its pictures to appear gradually as visitors scroll instead of all at once.
avoid_when: The ten photo slots are fixed Unsplash links and repeat the same few pictures, so the wall looks thin.
customise: No props: the heading and the ten image links are written in the file, and the reveal threshold sits in the viewport options given to each photo.
weight_why: Ten remote photos load at once and each keeps a viewport observer.

a11y.note: Every photo has an empty alt, so the wall carries no descriptions, and reduced-motion is never checked.

issues: The same few photos repeat down the wall, so nine slots show only a handful of images.
Three columns stay on phones, so pictures shrink to narrow slivers.
Frame 1 is almost empty, with one clipped photo at the bottom edge.
polish_why: Calm fade and a clean masonry wall; no captions, repeated photos and a bare heading.
